responsibility: Public general-purpose-register intrinsic header for 32-bit x86, exposing scalar helper intrinsics such as bit-scan, byte-swap, CRC32, RDPMC, RDTSC, rotates, pauses, and related builtins through GCC's x86 builtin layer. It is the 32-bit companion to x86gprintrin.h and provides the user-facing API for non-SIMD IA-32 machine instructions.
